CREATIVE ARTS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #10
====

GRADE: Grade 5
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Athletics: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Athletics.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Athletics.
   C. Practise Athletics with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Athletics.

   D. Refuse all feedback on Fabric Decoration.

   B. Practise Melody with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

   D. Disrupt classmates during Melody.

10. Best practice when working on Descant Recorder: (1 mark)

   D. Disrupt classmates during Swimming 15 Or 2.6 Indigenous Kenyan Games 15 3.0 Appreciation in Creative Arts .

12. Best practice when working on Painting and Mosaic: (1 mark)

14. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. The ticket price
   B. Only the volume
   C. Only the costume
   D. The speed of the music

15. Best practice when working on Kenyan Folk Dance: (1 mark)
